_doc: Demo48 thermal plan (DUAL). A game: sources driven by the valves / bath temperature. All sources real (no special setting).

hot_pipe.level: 0 → 0.6 while the LEFT valve is held (steam grows with time)
hot_pipe.why: real hot-spring steam from the pipe on your left

cold_pipe.level: 0 → 0.6 while the RIGHT valve is held (splash)
cold_pipe.why: real cold mountain water splashing from the right

bath.why: the steam / chill rising from the little bath in front of you

monkey_baths.az: left bath (hot, mother) / right bath (lukewarm, child)

rain.why: cold autumn rain; steam still rising = cool + warm together

showcase.fast_switch: tap left then right valve: left warm → right cool within ~1 s (and the same bath goes warm → cool when you over-cool it)
showcase.peak: the monkey mother's hot bath on the left 0.7 + steam 0.6 → capped 0.9
showcase.direction: hot pipe LEFT vs cold pipe RIGHT, always
showcase.same_ear_dual: rain (cool) + bath steam (warm) on both ears in stage 4
